title: AURA journal aerostatic bearing L4 dual benchmark family holdout validation
description: AURA's second public engineering-evidence anchor candidate. L4 dual benchmark family holdout validation across Kozánek aerostatic journal bearing family (within-family holdout, 2 rows) and Fleming/NASA externally pressurized gas-lubricated journal bearing family (second-source holdout, 2 rows). Combined L4 predicate PASS. Leakage audit PASS for both families. Target echo firewall ACTIVE.
author: O. Breshev
_lifecycle_state_note: Candidate at commit-ready package stage. Promote to public_anchor only after registry commit plus review/verification period or external methodology-paper review.
_acceptance_level_note: L4 is the AURA internal validation-maturity criterion (per methodology paper Eq 30), NOT an external universal standard. Internal naming retained for honesty about claim scope.

family_source.citation: Kozánek J, Šimek J, Steinbauer P, Bílkovský A. Identification of stiffness and damping coefficients of aerostatic journal bearing. Engineering Mechanics 2009;16(3):209-220
family_source.physical_setup: Rotor Kit Bently Nevada superstructure at CTU Prague; piezo-actuator harmonic excitation in two orthogonal directions; bearings designed by Techlab Ltd Prague (type A center-row orifices, type B two-row quarter-position orifices); eight orifices evenly located per row

family_source.citation: Fleming DP, Thayer WJ, Cunningham RE. Experimental dynamic stiffness and damping of externally pressurized gas-lubricated journal bearings. NASA TN D-8270; 1976
family_source.physical_setup: NASA Lewis Research Center experimental rig for externally pressurized gas-lubricated journal bearings; foundational dataset for dynamic stiffness and damping identification
family_source.independence_from_kozanek: Fully independent — different experimental facility, different country, different decade, different bearing design class. Confirmed by review of both sources.

benchmark_families._calibration_rows_note: Fleming/NASA family used purely as second-source holdout — no rows used for calibration

combined_L4_predicate.predicate_definition: L4 = PASS ⇔ H_Kozanek = PASS ∧ H_NASA = PASS ∧ N_hold_closed ≥ 4 ∧ L = PASS (per methodology paper Eq 30)
combined_L4_predicate._combined_mean_aggregation: Mean across all reported holdout residual entries from Kozánek (Kxx, Kyy, Cxx, Cyy for 2 rows = 8 entries) and Fleming/NASA (K, B(ω), critical_speed for 2 rows = 6 entries), total 14 residual entries

target_echo_firewall.mechanism: Calibration row IDs and holdout row IDs strictly disjoint per Eq (24). Holdout target values y*_hold excluded from β̂ fitting per Eq (26). Leakage audit predicate L per Eq (27): L = PASS ⇔ (IDs_train ∩ IDs_hold = ∅) ∧ (TargetEcho = FALSE).
target_echo_firewall.implementation_status: ACTIVE and PASS for this case
target_echo_firewall.novel_contribution: Target-echo firewall as explicit workflow operator is identified as a novel contribution of the methodology paper. Citation hook for external use of the framework.

methodology_paper_reference.title: Инженерная платформа AURA: evidence-gated workflow валидации и воспроизводимая поддержка инженерных решений для роторных систем на аэростатических опорах
methodology_paper_reference.authors: А. В. Брешев; В. Е. Брешев
methodology_paper_reference.status: in preparation for external review and submission
methodology_paper_reference.language: Russian (working language); English version planned for external submission

applicable_scope: Aerostatic journal bearing configurations within Kozánek family scope (eight-orifice type-A center-row or type-B two-row quarter-position designs at operating conditions documented in Kozánek 2009)
Externally pressurized gas-lubricated journal bearing configurations within Fleming/NASA TN D-8270 scope
non_applicable_scope: Conical aerostatic bearings (see VCR_BRESHEV_CONICAL_P05_METHOD_CHAIN_001 for separate validation)
Aerostatic thrust bearings (no validated case yet)
Porous aerostatic bearings (no validated case yet)
Hybrid hydrostatic-aerostatic bearings (no validated case yet)
applicability_assessment.scope_expansion_path: Per methodology paper §11 + Eq (31): S_expansion = S_production \ S_validated. Future work includes (a) third or fourth independent benchmark family, (b) full two-way Reynolds perturbation solver, (c) AURA-controlled experimental test cases for in-house validation.

lifecycle_log.rationale: Initial commit of L4 dual benchmark family validation evidence supporting article v15 methodology paper claims. Second public engineering-evidence anchor in the AURA registry, parallel to VCR_BRESHEV_CONICAL_P05_METHOD_CHAIN_001 for the conical aerostatic case.

limitations_and_what_this_anchor_does_no: L4 is the AURA internal validation-maturity criterion, NOT a formal external universal standard such as ASME V&V or ISO compliance
Holdout split done by row IDs — physical similarity between training and holdout configurations within the same family is reduced but not eliminated
Leakage audit checks ID disjointness and target echo absence — does NOT exhaustively check for indirect leakage through model structure or hyperparameter selection

Damping residuals up to 10.282% reflect physical sensitivity of damping coefficient identification to perturbation amplitude, excitation frequency, phase interpretation, gas compressibility, and numerical differentiation. Documented expected behavior per methodology paper §6.
Decision verdict 'L4 PASS' supports benchmark-scope engineering freeze for the documented benchmark families ONLY
Decision verdict does NOT support arbitrary-geometry production release — S_expansion remains non-empty per Eq (31)
Current scope is one-way support → rotor handoff; full two-way Reynolds perturbation coupling is future work per methodology paper §11
External independent third-party verification of the AURA implementation has NOT been performed
Residual values shown here do NOT transfer to bearing geometries materially outside the documented benchmark families
